entries.dialogueText: “You don't have to wait long, Mr. Rayne. As a gesture of faith in our newfound partnership, I will invite you to a special meeting in the future.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He grinned and let out a laugh. The check was right between his hands.

entries.dialogueText: “Did you just try to bribe the President of Sordland? I refuse!”
entries.menuText: “Did you just try to bribe the President of Sordland? I refuse!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Be careful, Tusk, or you will have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Be careful, Tusk, or you will have to make your deals in a prison cell.”
entries.menuText: “Be careful, Tusk, or you will have to make your deals in a prison cell.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“My goal was to begin a mutually be..."
entries.dialogueText: “My goal was to begin a mutually beneficial partnership. Nothing more, I assure you.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I think we started off on the wron..."
entries.dialogueText: “I think we started off on the wrong foot here.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Well, I will excuse myself then. T..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, I will excuse myself then. Thank you for your time.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Until you come back with a better..."
entries.dialogueText: “Until you come back with a better offer, the answer is no.”
entries.menuText: “Until you come back with a better offer, the answer is no.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Very well, then. We will be in tou..."
entries.dialogueText: “Very well, then. We will be in touch. I still think this was a good start for a beneficial partnership in the future.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Walter sighed and pulled the check..."
entries.dialogueText: Walter sighed and pulled the check away, putting it in his pocket.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Here is my final offer. Do not try..."
entries.dialogueText: “Here is my final offer. Do not try to bribe me again or you will have to make your deals in a prison cell.”
entries.menuText: “Here is my final offer. Do not try to bribe me again or you will have to make your deals in a prison cell.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Walter sighed and pulled the check away, putting it in his pocket.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She and I took a moment to look out..."
entries.dialogueText: She and I took a moment to look out over the lights of the city before heading to the elevators.

entries.dialogueText: "In my opinion, not investing in our infrastructure was a missed opportunity. But the government could still work on an economic relief package."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The intention of the administratio..."
entries.dialogueText: "The intention of the administration is to boost the economy overall."
entries.menuText: "The intention of the administration is to boost the economy overall."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our goal is to focus on the needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our goal is to focus on the needs of the people, not businesses."
entries.menuText: "Our goal is to focus on the needs of the people, not businesses."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our goal is to focus on the needs..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our goal is to focus on the needs of the businesses."
entries.menuText: "Our goal is to focus on the needs of the businesses."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""The most important goal is to dive..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most important goal is to divert investments where most profits can be made for the treasury. These are businesses."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""I do understand where you are comi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do understand where you are coming from but the businesses will help these people get employed."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""Glad to hear that because the unem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to hear that because the unemployment rate won't decrease otherwise."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""If the package ends up bailing out..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the package ends up bailing out the businesses that have suffered under this recession, they could provide employment and help the economy recover."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""What do you think, Mr. Rayne, woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think, Mr. Rayne, wouldn't that be good?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled a check out of his pocket..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled a check out of his pocket and slid it towards me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My personal bank details were liste..."
entries.dialogueText: My personal bank details were listed on it, showing a deposit of 500,000 Sordish Ren ready to be transferred. This amount was equivalent to six months of the presidential budget.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""Let's start with a gesture of good..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's start with a gesture of goodwill. Soon the economic relief package will be presented and it will either bail out businesses or provide checks for people."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""We can be close allies. The Group..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can be close allies. The Group can help you get Sordland out of the recession. Which will be the key problem to solve in your term and could even determine to your re-election."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He put his index finger on the chec..."
entries.dialogueText: He put his index finger on the check.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm so sorry, Mr. Tusk, but all I could find was a 1942 Sevigny. I hope that's acceptable."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She quickly put the tray on my desk..."
entries.dialogueText: She quickly put the tray on my desk and walked out. Tusk eyed her as she left.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: ""Remind me to visit your office mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me to visit your office more often. Now, where were we? Do we have a deal?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: As I walked out I noticed Livia still there, covering up her typewriter for the evening.

entries.speaker: Livia Suno
entries.title: Livia Suno: ""If I may be so bold, Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may be so bold, Mr. President... did you accept his offer?"

entries.speaker: Livia Suno

entries.dialogueText: "The other girls have told me about all kinds of dealings that went on during the Alphonso administration. I wasn't sure if you were that kind of president."
